  • Class
    Description
    CompressedPackageResourceProxy
    A conformance resource of a package that is registered in the worker context with the metadata of the package index only, and parsed when it's first used (lazy loading, like core's SimpleWorkerContext.PackageResourceLoader for packages on the filesystem).
    CompressedPackageResourceProxy.ResourceParser
    Parses the file content of a resource into an R5 resource.
    LazyTerminologyLoader
    Registers the terminology resources (CodeSystem, ValueSet, NamingSystem, ConceptMap) of a package as CompressedPackageResourceProxy objects, which are parsed when they're first used (lazy loading).
    LazyTerminologyLoader.OidRegistration
    The OIDs of a CodeSystem or NamingSystem, see LazyTerminologyLoader.readOids(org.hl7.fhir.utilities.npm.NpmPackage.PackageResourceInformation, byte[]).
    MetadataCoreVersionPinner
    Pins the canonical references of the resources of a core package to the versions of the referenced resources, like org.hl7.fhir.r5.context.CoreVersionPinner does when the core package is loaded (SimpleWorkerContext.finishLoading()).
